Definition: to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
BiblicalUsage: 1) to totter, shake, slip; 1a) (Qal) to totter, shake, slip; 1b) (Niphal) to be shaken, be moved, be overthrown; 1c) (Hiphil) to dislodge, let fall, drop; 1d) (Hithpael) to be greatly shaken
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
